name: WeaponRangesRebalanced
author: Luca
description: Realistic configurable weapon ranges, a configurable thrown-grenade range cap (default 2 squares), proportional secondary-range synchronization, exact overrides via UserData/WeaponRangesRebalanced/weapon-overrides.json, and the long-range indirect-fire AI positioning fix. Jiangyu port of the GameplaySuite WRR module; options live in the MenaceModSettings window (F9).
